052/**
053 * The {@code ViewerFrame} class defines the main window of the PAINT Viewer.
054 * It combines left and right image panels, navigation controls, and metadata panels into
055 * a cohesive interface for browsing, filtering, and analyzing experiment recordings.
056 * <p>
057 * Functionally, the class manages synchronization between user interactions and the
058 * underlying model objects — specifically {@link RecordingEntry}
059 * and {@link paint.shared.objects.Recording}. It enables users to:
060 * <ul>
061 *   <li>Navigate through multiple recordings within an experiment.</li>
062 *   <li>Filter visible squares using configurable thresholds.</li>
063 *   <li>Assign cell IDs interactively via selection dialogs.</li>
064 *   <li>Play TIFF/ND2 recordings directly from disk.</li>
065 *   <li>Preview live recalculations of Tau, R², and density metrics.</li>
066 * </ul>
067 * <p>
068 * This class is instantiated by {@link paint.viewer.app.Viewer} after successful
069 * project initialization. All UI updates occur on the Swing event dispatch thread.
070 */
071public class ViewerFrame extends JFrame implements
072        RecordingControlsPanel.RecordingsControlListener,
073        SquareControlDialog.SquareControlListener,
074        NavigationPanel.Listener,
075        ViewerLayoutBuilder.CloseListener {
076

107    /**
108     * Constructs a {@code RecordingViewerFrame} that initializes and displays the complete
109     * recording viewer environment. The frame sets up grid visualization, navigation,
110     * control, and attribute panels while establishing event connections for user actions.
111     *
112     * @param project          the {@link Project} object providing experiment context and paths.
113     * @param recordingEntries list of {@link RecordingEntry} objects representing loaded recordings.
114     */
115    public ViewerFrame(Project project, List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries) {
116        super("Recording Viewer - " + project.getProjectRootPath().getFileName());
117        this.project                 = project;
118        this.allRecordingEntries     = new ArrayList<>(recordingEntries);                          // This is the unfiltered set of recordings
119        this.recordingEntries        = new ArrayList<>(recordingEntries);                          // This is the filtered set of recordings
120        this.writeRecordingOverride  = new WriteRecordingOverride(project.getProjectRootPath());
121        this.writeSquareOverride     = new WriteSquareOverride(project.getProjectRootPath());
122        this.navigator               = new RecordingNavigator(this::showRecordingEntry);
123
124        setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
125        setLayout(new BorderLayout());
126        setResizable(false);
127
128        // The grid must be square. Validate exactly that, rather than checking against a hardcoded
129        // list of layouts: the list used to be {25, 100, 225, 400, 900} while the dropdown the user
130        // actually picks from offers 5x5 .. 40x40 ({25, 100, 225, 400, 625, 900, 1225, 1600}), so
131        // choosing 25x25, 35x35 or 40x40 made the Viewer reject a perfectly valid project.
132        //
133        // Use the same one definition of the square-count -> grid-side conversion as the pipeline.
134        int numberOfSquaresInRecording   = PaintConfig.getInt(GENERATE_SQUARES, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, -1);
135        int numberOfSquareInOneDimension = GenerateSquaresConfig.gridSizeFor(numberOfSquaresInRecording);
136
137        if (numberOfSquaresInRecording <= 0
138                || numberOfSquareInOneDimension * numberOfSquareInOneDimension != numberOfSquaresInRecording) {
139            // Fail loudly. This used to `return` from the constructor, which left leftGridPanel,
140            // displayUpdater, attributesPanel, navigationPanel and controlsPanel all null — and
141            // Viewer then called setVisible(true) on the half-built frame regardless, giving an
142            // empty window that threw NullPointerException on any interaction.
143            throw new IllegalStateException(String.format(
144                    "'%s' is %d, which is not a square grid; the Viewer cannot display it.",
145                    NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, numberOfSquaresInRecording));
146        }
147
148        // --- Build UI layout using the layout builder ---
149        ViewerLayoutBuilder builder = new ViewerLayoutBuilder();
150
151        ViewerLayoutBuilder.LayoutComponents ui =
152                builder.build(
153                        numberOfSquareInOneDimension,
154                        this,
155                        this,
156                        this
157                );
158        // Apply content pane
159        setContentPane(ui.rootPanel);
160
161        // Store references
162        this.leftGridPanel           = ui.leftGridPanel;
163        JLabel rightImageLabel       = ui.rightImageLabel;
164        JLabel experimentLabel       = ui.experimentLabel;
165        JLabel recordingLabel        = ui.recordingLabel;
166        this.attributesPanel         = ui.attributesPanel;
167        this.navigationPanel         = ui.navigationPanel;
168        this.controlsPanel           = ui.controlsPanel;
169        this.importOverridesCheckBox = ui.importOverridesCheckBox;
170
171        this.displayUpdater = new RecordingDisplayUpdater(
172                this.leftGridPanel,
173                rightImageLabel,
174                experimentLabel,
175                recordingLabel,
176                this.attributesPanel
177        );
178
179        // Wire behaviour for "Overrides" checkbox
180        initImportOverridesBehaviour();
181
182        setSize(1500, 700);
183        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
184
185        // Load the first entry if available
186        if (!recordingEntries.isEmpty()) {
187            showRecordingEntry(0);
188        }
189    }
190
191    /**
192     * Initializes startup and runtime behaviour for the "Import Overrides" checkbox:
193     * - If checked at startup → perform override import once.
194     * - If user checks it later → perform override import.
195     * - If user unchecks it → show a message asking to restart the viewer.
196     */
197    private void initImportOverridesBehaviour() {
198        if (importOverridesCheckBox == null) {
199            return;
200        }
201
202        // Set initial label based on initial state
203        importOverridesCheckBox.setText(
204                importOverridesCheckBox.isSelected() ? OVERRIDE_TEXT_ON : OVERRIDE_TEXT_OFF
205        );
206
207        importOverridesCheckBox.addItemListener(e -> {
208            boolean selected = importOverridesCheckBox.isSelected();
209
210            // Update title immediately
211            importOverridesCheckBox.setText(selected ? OVERRIDE_TEXT_ON : OVERRIDE_TEXT_OFF);
212
213            // Your existing behavior
214            if (selected) {
215                performImportOverrides();
216            } else {
217                // Optional: tell user they must restart to fully “unimport”
218                // JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this, "To remove imported overrides, restart the viewer.", ...);
219            }
220        });
221
222        // Startup behavior: if already selected, import once
223        if (importOverridesCheckBox.isSelected()) {
224            performImportOverrides();
225        }
226
227        importOverridesCheckBox.setToolTipText(
228                "When enabled, reads override CSV files and applies them to the current session."
229        );
230    }
231
232    /**
233     * Performs the actual "Import Overrides" action by reading override CSV files
234     * and applying them to the current project's recording and square metadata.
235     */
236    private void performImportOverrides() {
237        PaintLogger.debugf("Overrides requested (checkbox is checked).");
238
239        // 1) Apply overrides to all RecordingEntry objects
240        importRecordingOverrides (allRecordingEntries, project.getProjectRootPath());
241        importSquareOverrides    (allRecordingEntries, project.getProjectRootPath());
242        importRecordingExcludes  (allRecordingEntries, project.getProjectRootPath());
243
244        // 2) Re-apply filter for the currently visible recording
245        if (recordingEntries.isEmpty()
246                || currentIndex < 0
247                || currentIndex >= recordingEntries.size()) {
248            leftGridPanel.repaint();
249            return;
250        }
251
252        RecordingEntry current = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
253
254        // Build params from the now-updated recording
255        SquareControlParams params = new SquareControlParams(
256                current.getRecording().getMinRequiredDensityRatio(),
257                current.getRecording().getMaxAllowableVariability(),
258                current.getRecording().getMinRequiredRSquared(),
259                current.getRecording().getNeighbourMode()
260        );
261
262        // 3) Re-apply control handler + filter to the grid
263        controlHandler.apply(params, leftGridPanel);
264        leftGridPanel.applyVisibilityFilter();
265
266        // 4) Update the attributes panel preview to reflect the new thresholds
267        int numSquares = PaintConfig.getInt(GENERATE_SQUARES, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, -1);
268        attributesPanel.updatePreview(
269                current,
270                numSquares,
271                params.minRequiredDensityRatio,
272                params.maxAllowableVariability,
273                params.minRequiredRSquared,
274                params.neighbourMode
275        );
276
277        // 5) Redraw the left grid
278        leftGridPanel.repaint();
279
280        // Ensure UI reflects new exclude state after import
281        if (displayUpdater != null) {
282            displayUpdater.applyExcludedUi(current);
283        }
284        if (controlsPanel != null) {
285            controlsPanel.setExcludeButtonText(current.getRecording().isExcluded());
286        }
287    }

289    /**
290     * Updates the navigation buttons based on the current index position.
291     * Enables "previous" or "next" navigation only when appropriate.
292     */
293    private void updateNavButtons() {
294        navigationPanel.setEnabledState(currentIndex > 0, currentIndex < recordingEntries.size() - 1);
295    }

297    /**
298     * Displays a specific recording entry by index, updating both left and right
299     * image panels and all related attribute components.
300     *
301     * @param index the target recording index to display.
302     */
303    private void showRecordingEntry(int index) {
304        // Reset grid interaction deterministically
305        leftGridPanel.setInteractionEnabled(true);
306        leftGridPanel.setSelectionEnabled(false);
307        leftGridPanel.setInfoPopupsEnabled(true);
308
309        if (index < 0 || index >= recordingEntries.size()) {
310            return;
311        }
312
313        assignmentManager.clear();
314
315        // clear grid selection
316        leftGridPanel.clearSelection();
317        leftGridPanel.applyVisibilityFilter();
318
319        currentIndex = index;
320        RecordingEntry entry = recordingEntries.get(index);
321        displayUpdater.show(entry, index, recordingEntries.size());
322        updateNavButtons();
323
324        // --- Ensure Exclude/Include UI always matches the current recording ---
325        if (controlsPanel != null) {
326            controlsPanel.setExcludeButtonText(entry.getRecording().isExcluded());
327        }
328    }

406    /**
407     * Toggles the excluded state of the current recording and updates the
408     * project-level exclude CSV and experiment-level recordings CSV.
409     */
410    @Override
411    public void onExcludeToggleRequested() {
412        if (recordingEntries.isEmpty()
413                || currentIndex < 0
414                || currentIndex >= recordingEntries.size()) {
415            Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
416            return;
417        }
418
419        RecordingEntry entry = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
420
421        // Toggle the in-memory state. (This used to be set twice, identically, in a row.)
422        boolean newExcluded = !entry.getRecording().isExcluded();
423        entry.getRecording().setExcluded(newExcluded);
424
425        // Record it in the Viewer's exclude file. That file — not the Exclude column of
426        // Recordings.csv — is the authoritative record of which recordings the user excluded:
427        // both ImportRecordingExclude and ExportOverridesFromViewer rebuild the column from it.
428        String recordingName = entry.getRecording().getRecordingName();
429        updateExcludeRecordingsCsv(project.getProjectRootPath(), recordingName, newExcluded);
430
431        // 3) Update UI (button text + labels)
432        controlsPanel.setExcludeButtonText(newExcluded);
433        if (displayUpdater != null) {
434            displayUpdater.applyExcludedUi(entry);
435        }
436
437    }

439    // =========================================================================================
440    // MODAL DIALOG LIFECYCLE
441    // =========================================================================================
442
443    /**
444     * Opens a modal dialog exclusively, and guarantees the UI is restored when it closes.
445     * <p>
446     * Every modal dialog in this frame needs the same ceremony: refuse to open if one is
447     * already up, disable the action buttons, put the grid into some temporary state, and then
448     * undo all of that when the dialog closes. That was previously copy-pasted at each call
449     * site, and it is exactly the kind of duplication you do not want: if one copy forgets to
450     * re-enable the buttons, or forgets to clear {@link #activeDialog}, the viewer locks up
451     * for good. Doing it once, here, makes that impossible to get wrong.
452     * <p>
453     * The created dialog is returned so a caller can read its result from its own reference.
454     * Do not read {@link #activeDialog} after the dialog closes — the close listener clears it.
455     *
456     * @param factory  creates the dialog (called only once it is certain we can open one)
457     * @param prepare  temporary UI state to apply while the dialog is up
458     * @param restore  undoes {@code prepare}; always run when the dialog closes
459     * @return the dialog that was shown, or {@code null} if one was already open
460     */
461    private <D extends JDialog> D showExclusiveDialog(java.util.function.Supplier<D> factory,
462                                                      Runnable prepare,
463                                                      Runnable restore) {
464        if (activeDialog != null && activeDialog.isShowing()) {
465            Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
466            return null;
467        }
468
469        setActionButtonsEnabled(false);
470        leftGridPanel.hideSquareInfoIfVisible();
471        prepare.run();
472
473        D dialog = factory.get();
474        activeDialog = dialog;
475
476        dialog.addWindowListener(new java.awt.event.WindowAdapter() {
477            @Override
478            public void windowClosed(java.awt.event.WindowEvent e) {
479                restore.run();
480                setActionButtonsEnabled(true);
481                activeDialog = null;
482            }
483        });
484
485        dialog.setVisible(true);   // modal: blocks until closed
486        return dialog;
487    }

489    // =========================================================================================
490    // FILTER AND CONTROL REQUEST HANDLERS
491    // =========================================================================================
492
493    /**
494     * Invoked when the user opens the filter dialog.
495     * The dialog allows narrowing the visible recording list by user-defined criteria.
496     * Once the user confirms, the filtered result is applied immediately to the viewer.
497     */
498    @Override
499    public void onFilterRequested() {
500
501        RecordingFilterDialog fd = showExclusiveDialog(
502                () -> new RecordingFilterDialog(this, recordingEntries, allRecordingEntries, lastFilterCriteria),
503                () -> setGridEnabled(false),
504                () -> setGridEnabled(true));
505
506        if (fd == null) {
507            return;   // another dialog was already open
508        }
509
510        // Read the result from our own reference: activeDialog has been cleared by the close
511        // listener by now, and reading it here used to be a latent NPE.
512        if (!fd.isCancelled()) {
513            List<RecordingEntry> filtered = fd.getFilteredRecordings();
514            lastFilterCriteria = fd.getCurrentFilterCriteria();
515            boolean isResetAll = (filtered.size() == allRecordingEntries.size());
516
517            if (isResetAll) {
518                recordingEntries.clear();
519                recordingEntries.addAll(allRecordingEntries);
520                currentIndex = 0;
521                showRecordingEntry(currentIndex);
522                PaintLogger.infof("Filter reset — showing all recordings (%d total).", recordingEntries.size());
523                return;
524            }
525
526            if (!filtered.isEmpty()) {
527                recordingEntries.clear();
528                recordingEntries.addAll(filtered);
529                currentIndex = 0;
530                showRecordingEntry(currentIndex);
531                PaintLogger.infof("Filter applied — showing %d of %d recordings.", filtered.size(), allRecordingEntries.size());
532            } else {
533                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
534                        this,
535                        "No recordings match the selected filter criteria.",
536                        "No Results",
537                        JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE
538                );
539            }
540        }
541    }

570    /**
571     * Opens a dialog for assigning a cell ID to the user-selected squares.
572     * If previous assignments exist for the current recording, the user is
573     * asked whether to merge the new assignments with the old ones or to
574     * replace all existing assignments entirely.
575     * A CANCEL option aborts the operation without modifying any data.
576     * Includes undo and cancel functions and temporarily disables regular grid
577     * selection until the dialog is closed.
578     */
579    @Override
580    public void onAssignCellsRequested() {
581
582        final JFrame owner = this;
583
584        showExclusiveDialog(
585                () -> new CellAssignmentDialog(owner, new CellAssignmentDialog.Listener() {
586                    public void onAssign(int cellId) {
587                        handleCellAssignment(cellId);
588                    }
589
590                    public void onUndo() {
591                        assignmentManager.undo(leftGridPanel);
592                    }
593
594                    public void onCancelSelection() {
595                        leftGridPanel.clearSelection();
596                        leftGridPanel.applyVisibilityFilter();
597                        leftGridPanel.repaint();
598                    }
599                }),
600                // While assigning, the grid becomes a selection surface rather than an
601                // info surface.
602                () -> {
603                    leftGridPanel.setSelectionEnabled(true);
604                    leftGridPanel.setInfoPopupsEnabled(false);
605                },
606                () -> {
607                    leftGridPanel.setSelectionEnabled(false);
608                    leftGridPanel.setInfoPopupsEnabled(true);
609                });
610    }
611
612    private void handleCellAssignment(int cellId) {
613        Map<Integer, Integer> userSelectedSquares = assignmentManager.assignUserSelectedSquares(cellId, leftGridPanel);
614
615        if (userSelectedSquares.isEmpty()) {
616            return;
617        }
618
619        RecordingEntry current                = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
620        boolean        hasExistingOverrides   = writeSquareOverride.hasOverridesFor(current);
621        boolean        existingOverridesShown = (importOverridesCheckBox != null && importOverridesCheckBox.isSelected());
622        boolean        keepOld                = true;
623
624        // If there are existing overrides and if thgey are not shown ask
625        if (hasExistingOverrides && !existingOverridesShown && assignmentManager.isFirstAssignmentForRecording()) {
626            int choice = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(
627                    this,
628                    "There are existing cell assignments for this recording.\n\n" +
629                            "Do you want to keep those and only update the selected squares?\n\n" +
630                            "Choose 'Yes' to merge assignments.\n" +
631                            "Choose 'No' to replace all existing assignments.",
632                    "Existing Assignments Found",
633                    JOptionPane.YES_NO_CANCEL_OPTION,
634                    JOptionPane.QUESTION_MESSAGE
635            );
636
637            if (choice == JOptionPane.CANCEL_OPTION || choice == JOptionPane.CLOSED_OPTION) {
638                return;
639            }
640
641            keepOld = (choice == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION);
642        }
643        assignmentManager.setFirstAssignmentForRecording(false);
644
645        if (keepOld) {
646            writeSquareOverride.mergeSquareOverrides(current, userSelectedSquares);
647        } else {
648            writeSquareOverride.replaceSquareOverrides(current, userSelectedSquares);
649        }
650    }

689    // =========================================================================================
690    // APPLYING SQUARE CONTROL PARAMETERS
691    // =========================================================================================
692
693    /**
694     * Applies square control parameters from the dialog to the current grid or project scope.
695     * <p>
696     * When invoked in "Preview" mode, recalculates Tau, R², and density values dynamically
697     * without committing them to disk. For full application, thresholds are persisted via
698     * {@link WriteRecordingOverride}.
699     *
700     * @param scope  the operational scope ("Preview" or "Apply").
701     * @param params parameter bundle defining the visibility thresholds and neighbour mode.
702     */
703
704    @Override
705    public void onApplySquareControl(SquareControlDialog.SquareControlListener.Scope scope,
706            SquareControlParams params) {
707
708        if (scope == SquareControlDialog.SquareControlListener.Scope.PREVIEW) {
709            controlHandler.apply(params, leftGridPanel);
710            leftGridPanel.applyVisibilityFilter();
711
712            RecordingEntry currentRecordingEntry = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
713            int numSquares = PaintConfig.getInt(GENERATE_SQUARES, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, -1);
714
715            //  --- Reflect results in attribute preview panel ---
716            attributesPanel.updatePreview(
717                    currentRecordingEntry,
718                    numSquares,
719                    params.minRequiredDensityRatio,
720                    params.maxAllowableVariability,
721                    params.minRequiredRSquared,
722                    params.neighbourMode
723            );
724
725            leftGridPanel.repaint();
726            return;
727        }
728
729        // Full application: persist thresholds and repaint
730        controlHandler.apply(params, leftGridPanel);
731        writeRecordingOverride.writeRecordingOverridesToFile(scope.label(), params, recordingEntries, currentIndex);
732        leftGridPanel.repaint();
733    }

735    // =========================================================================================
736    // RECORDING PLAYBACK HANDLER
737    // =========================================================================================
738
739    /**
740     * Initiates playback of the ND2 or TIFF file corresponding to the current recording.
741     * Performs validation of user selection and file presence before launching playback.
742     * Errors and missing files are reported via dialog boxes.
743     */
744
745    @Override
746    public void onPlayRecordingRequested() {
747        if (activeDialog != null && activeDialog.isShowing()) {
748            Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
749            return;
750        }
751        if (playbackController.isPlaying()) {
752            Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
753            return;
754        }
755        if (recordingEntries.isEmpty() || currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex >= recordingEntries.size()) {
756            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
757                                          "No recording selected to play.",
758                                          "No Selection",
759                                          JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
760            return;
761        }
762        RecordingEntry entry = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
763        playbackController.playRecording(entry);
764    }

776    private void openSquaresForCurrentRecording() {
777        try {
778            // currentIndex indexes recordingEntries — the *filtered* list — as it does everywhere
779            // else. This used to read allRecordingEntries, so with any filter applied it opened a
780            // different recording's squares. It went unnoticed because applying a filter did
781            // nothing (the Apply button was wired to the cancel path), so the two lists never
782            // diverged.
783            RecordingEntry current = recordingEntries.get(currentIndex);
784            String experimentName  = current.getExperimentName();
785            String recordingName   = current.getRecordingName();
786            FileHelper.filterAndOpenSquaresCsv(project.getProjectRootPath(), experimentName, recordingName);
787        } catch (IOException ex) {
788            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
789                                          "Error opening squares CSV:\n" + ex.getMessage(),
790                                          "Error",
791                                          JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
792        }
793    }

832    @Override
833    public void onClose() {
834        if (importOverridesCheckBox != null && importOverridesCheckBox.isSelected()) {
835
836            int choice = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(
837                    this,
838                    "You are about to save override data into '-override' files.\n"
839                            + "This may take a while.\n\n"
840                            + "Do you want to save overrides now?",
841                    "Process Overrides?",
842                    JOptionPane.YES_NO_CANCEL_OPTION,
843                    JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE
844            );
845
846            if (choice == JOptionPane.CANCEL_OPTION) {
847                // User aborted closing
848                return;
849            }
850
851            if (choice == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) {
852                try {
853                    exportOverrides(project.getProjectRootPath(), "-override");
854                } catch (Exception ex) {
855                    PaintLogger.error("Failed to export overrides", ex);
856                    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
857                            this,
858                            "Error while processing overrides:\n" + ex.getMessage(),
859                            "Error",
860                            JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE
861                    );
862                }
863            }
864
865            // NO_OPTION → skip override processing and continue closing
866        }
867
868        // Always close the window afterwards
869        this.dispose();
870    }
